def load_workspace(folder: str | Path,
                   state_subdir: str = DEFAULT_STATE_SUBDIR):
    """Load the Workspace for a project folder; raise NotAProject if absent."""
    from ..config import workspace as _ws
    layout = assert_project(folder, state_subdir)
    w = _ws.load(layout.state_dir)
    if w is None:
        raise NotAProject(str(layout.workspace_path))
    return w


def save_workspace(folder: str | Path, w,
                   state_subdir: str = DEFAULT_STATE_SUBDIR) -> None:
    """Save a Workspace; validate happens inside _ws.save.

    Raises ValueError on validation failure (nested roots, duplicate
    basename, reserved name).
    """
    from ..config import workspace as _ws
    layout = resolve_layout(folder, state_subdir)
    if not _ws.save(w, layout.state_dir):
        # _ws.save returns False when validate() raised; run validate
        # again to surface the concrete reason to the caller.
        _ws.validate(w)
        raise RuntimeError("failed to write workspace.json")


def list_roots(folder: str | Path, state_subdir: str = DEFAULT_STATE_SUBDIR):
    """Return a list of dicts: {name, path, include, exclude, policy}.

    Policy is a plain dict (read/write/index_docs/index_py/index_lua).
    """
    w = load_workspace(folder, state_subdir)
    out = []
    for name in w.root_names():
        r = w.roots[name]
        p = w.policy.get(name)
        out.append({
            "name": name,
            "path": r.path,
            "include": list(r.include),
            "exclude": list(r.exclude),
            "policy": {
                "read": bool(p.read) if p else True,
                "write": bool(p.write) if p else True,
                "index_docs": bool(p.index_docs) if p else True,
                "index_py": bool(p.index_py) if p else True,
                "index_lua": bool(p.index_lua) if p else True,
            },
        })
    return out


def add_root(folder: str | Path, root_path: str,
             state_subdir: str = DEFAULT_STATE_SUBDIR) -> str:
    """Add a root. Returns its derived name.

    Raises ValueError (nested / duplicate basename / reserved name /
    path missing) on failure. Saves on success.
    """
    from ..config import workspace as _ws
    p = Path(root_path).resolve()
    if not p.is_dir():
        raise ValueError(f"path is not a directory: {p}")
    w = load_workspace(folder, state_subdir)
    name = _ws.add_root(w, str(p))
    save_workspace(folder, w, state_subdir)
    return name


def remove_root(folder: str | Path, name: str,
                state_subdir: str = DEFAULT_STATE_SUBDIR) -> None:
    """Remove a root by name. No-op if absent. Saves on success."""
    w = load_workspace(folder, state_subdir)
    if name in w.roots:
        del w.roots[name]
        w.policy.pop(name, None)
        save_workspace(folder, w, state_subdir)


def update_root_policy(folder: str | Path, name: str,
                       flags: dict,
                       state_subdir: str = DEFAULT_STATE_SUBDIR) -> None:
    """Update a root's policy flags. `flags` is a partial dict.

    Accepted keys: read / write / index_docs / index_py / index_lua.
    Missing keys are left unchanged. Saves on success.
    """
    from ..config.workspace import RootPolicy
    w = load_workspace(folder, state_subdir)
    if name not in w.roots:
        raise KeyError(f"no such root: {name!r}")
    cur = w.policy.get(name) or RootPolicy()
    for k in ("read", "write", "index_docs", "index_py", "index_lua"):
        if k in flags:
            setattr(cur, k, bool(flags[k]))
    w.policy[name] = cur
    save_workspace(folder, w, state_subdir)


def rename_project(folder: str | Path, new_name: str,
                   state_subdir: str = DEFAULT_STATE_SUBDIR) -> None:
    """Rename the workspace. Saves on success."""
    w = load_workspace(folder, state_subdir)
    w.name = str(new_name)
    save_workspace(folder, w, state_subdir)

def _menu_project_settings() -> None:
    """Open the project settings dialog (roots + policies + name)."""
    proj = CONFIG.get("project_dir", "").strip()
    if not proj:
        messagebox.showwarning(
            "\u041d\u0435\u0442 \u043f\u0440\u043e\u0435\u043a\u0442\u0430",
            "\u0421\u043d\u0430\u0447\u0430\u043b\u0430 \u043e\u0442\u043a\u0440\u043e\u0439\u0442\u0435 \u0438\u043b\u0438 \u0441\u043e\u0437\u0434\u0430\u0439\u0442\u0435 \u043f\u0440\u043e\u0435\u043a\u0442 (File).",
            parent=root,
        )
        return
    state_subdir = _cfg.resolve_state_dir(CONFIG)
    try:
        w = _projects.load_workspace(proj, state_subdir)
    except _projects.NotAProject:
        messagebox.showerror(
            "\u041d\u0435 \u043f\u0440\u043e\u0435\u043a\u0442",
            f"\u0412 {proj} \u043d\u0435\u0442 workspace.json",
            parent=root,
        )
        return

    dlg = tk.Toplevel(root)
    dlg.title("Project settings")
    dlg.transient(root)
    dlg.grab_set()
    dlg.geometry("760x460")
    dlg.minsize(700, 420)

    main = tk.Frame(dlg, padx=12, pady=12)
    main.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

    name_row = tk.Frame(main)
    name_row.pack(fill="x", pady=(0, 8))
    tk.Label(name_row, text="Project name:").pack(side="left")
    name_var = tk.StringVar(value=w.name)
    tk.Entry(name_row, textvariable=name_var).pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(8, 0))

    tk.Label(main, text=f"Folder: {proj}", anchor="w", fg="#666").pack(fill="x")

    tk.Label(main, text="Roots:", anchor="w").pack(fill="x", pady=(10, 2))
    cols = ("name", "path", "R", "W", "Id", "Ip", "Il")
    tree = ttk.Treeview(main, columns=cols, show="headings", height=8)
    for c, w_ in zip(cols, (120, 380, 32, 32, 36, 36, 36)):
        tree.heading(c, text=c)
        tree.column(c, width=w_, anchor="w" if c in ("name", "path") else "center")
    tree.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

    def _reload_roots() -> None:
        for row in tree.get_children():
            tree.delete(row)
        try:
            roots = _projects.list_roots(proj, state_subdir)
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e), parent=dlg)
            return
        for r in roots:
            p = r["policy"]
            tree.insert("", "end", iid=r["name"], values=(
                r["name"], r["path"],
                "\u2713" if p["read"] else "\u2715",
                "\u2713" if p["write"] else "\u2715",
                "\u2713" if p["index_docs"] else "\u2715",
                "\u2713" if p["index_py"] else "\u2715",
                "\u2713" if p["index_lua"] else "\u2715",
            ))

    _reload_roots()

    def _add_root() -> None:
        folder = filedialog.askdirectory(title="Root folder", parent=dlg)
        if not folder:
            return
        try:
            _projects.add_root(proj, folder, state_subdir)
        except ValueError as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Cannot add root", str(e), parent=dlg)
            return
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e), parent=dlg)
            return
        _reload_roots()

    def _remove_root() -> None:
        sel = tree.selection()
        if not sel:
            return
        name = sel[0]
        if not messagebox.askyesno(
                "Remove root",
                f"Remove root {name!r} from this project?\n"
                "Files on disk are not touched.",
                parent=dlg):
            return
        try:
            _projects.remove_root(proj, name, state_subdir)
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e), parent=dlg)
            return
        _reload_roots()

    def _toggle_flag(flag_key: str) -> None:
        sel = tree.selection()
        if not sel:
            return
        name = sel[0]
        try:
            roots = {r["name"]: r for r in _projects.list_roots(proj, state_subdir)}
        except Exception:
            return
        cur = roots.get(name)
        if cur is None:
            return
        new_val = not bool(cur["policy"][flag_key])
        try:
            _projects.update_root_policy(proj, name, {flag_key: new_val}, state_subdir)
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e), parent=dlg)
            return
        _reload_roots()
        try:
            tree.selection_set(name)
        except Exception:
            pass

    ctrl_row = tk.Frame(main)
    ctrl_row.pack(fill="x", pady=(6, 0))
    tk.Button(ctrl_row, text="Add root\u2026", command=_add_root).pack(side="left")
    tk.Button(ctrl_row, text="Remove", command=_remove_root).pack(side="left", padx=(6, 0))
    tk.Label(ctrl_row, text="   Toggle:").pack(side="left", padx=(12, 0))
    for label, key in (("R", "read"), ("W", "write"),
                       ("Id", "index_docs"), ("Ip", "index_py"),
                       ("Il", "index_lua")):
        tk.Button(ctrl_row, text=label, width=3,
                  command=(lambda k=key: _toggle_flag(k))).pack(side="left", padx=(2, 0))

    btn_row = tk.Frame(main)
    btn_row.pack(fill="x", pady=(12, 0))

    def _ok() -> None:
        new_name = name_var.get().strip()
        if new_name and new_name != w.name:
            try:
                _projects.rename_project(proj, new_name, state_subdir)
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e), parent=dlg)
                return
        dlg.destroy()
        _switch_project(proj, new_name or None)

    tk.Button(btn_row, text="OK", command=_ok, width=10).pack(side="right")
    tk.Button(btn_row, text="Cancel", command=dlg.destroy, width=10).pack(side="right", padx=(0, 6))
